newsitem.title: USA: ImmuCell enters U.K. distribution agreement.
newsitem.headline: ImmuCell enters U.K. distribution agreement.

text.p: ImmuCell Corp said Wednesday its joint venture, Clearwater Diagnostics Co LLC, with New Jersey-based Membrex Inc entered into an exclusive distributor relationship with England-based Adreck Marketing Ltd for the sale of its Crypto-Scan water diagnostic test in the United Kingdom.

The Crypto-Scan test utilizes a patented vortex flow filtration technology to concentrate water samples, followed by an immuno-magnetic separation technology to further concentrate and clean up the samples for detection of Cryptosporidium oocysts.
Cryptosporidium causes severe diarrhea and can lead to death in immune-compromised people.

Kevin Shrimpton, president of Adreck, said, "We are especially excited about the potential for this new product given the severe drought conditions recently experienced in Europe, which have increased the already existing need for a test that can effectively and reliably detect this dangerous parasite."
In addition, ImmuCell said the Environmental Protection Agency has included Crypto-Scan in the Agency's new draft method to detect Cryptosporidium in drinking water.
ImmuCell is a biotechnology company developing and manufacturing an alternative to antibiotics and vaccines.
